title: Procedural Flow & Reveal Shaders: Baking Houdini Sims into Vertex Colors
summary: Explore how to procedurally grow blood flows in Houdini using Find Shortest Path and VDB processing, bake the simulation's time-of-arrival into vertex colors, and drive a smooth, customizable reveal shader at runtime in-engine.

title: Abusing Houdini APEX: Bone-Driven RBD Exports for Games
summary: Traditional game engine exports for rigid bodies often rely on automated SideFX Labs tools. Learn how to leverage Houdini's APEX rigging system to bind bones to fragments for precise hierarchies, naming, and animation control.

title: Optimizing Pyro Simulations in Houdini: A VEX-Based Approach
summary: In high-end film pipelines, simulating large-scale pyrotechnics efficiently is a constant challenge. Learn how to use VEX to prune simulation grids and optimize performance by 30-40%.
